summary: At the #monster action, C enters domindblast’s candidate loop and its first divergent RNG call is polyself.c:1921, while JavaScript emits the same opening blast text without the corresponding target-selection draws. By step 99 C displays “You lock in on the mind flayer’s latent telepathy” and JavaScript displays the mind flayer concentrating. The source owner is the existing whole-function polyself.c:domindblast implementation; compare its live candidate gates and inputs, including distance, peacefulness, mindlessness, telepathy, and vision. The current trace does not distinguish which gate or input differs.

source.branch: When u.uen is at least 10, domindblast spends 10 energy and walks fmon in list order. It skips dead monsters, monsters beyond BOLT_LIM squared, peaceful monsters, and mindless monsters. It targets a remaining monster when the hero senses it telepathically, when its species is telepathic and rn2(2) succeeds, or when rn2(10) is zero; a target takes rnd(15) damage after wakeup, and killed() runs if that damage is lethal.
callers: cmd.c:domonability (cmd.c:916) calls domindblast when is_mind_flayer(uptr); js/cmd.js:domonability (js/cmd.js:3567) routes the #monster command to the existing js/polyself.js:domindblast implementation.
dependencies: hack.h:mdistu supplies the squared-distance check; mondata.h:mindless and telepathic supply species predicates.
rnd.c:rn2 and rnd provide the ordered target-selection and damage draws.
mon.c:wakeup and killed perform the target wakeup, damage-death cleanup, and removal side effects.
